introduction: Luna and Gali have been best friends ever since they were kids. When Luna breaks up with her boyfriend, it is revealed that Gali has been waiting in the wings this whole time. Gali decides to take his shot and professes his love for Luna-but there's one problem. Luna, who swears by astrology and signs from the universe, is convinced that she in Gali are extremely incompatible because she is a Sagittarius while he is a Taurus. With Gali's persistence, Luna decides to give their relationship a chance, but bad luck follows the couple whenever they get together. This convinces Luna that their relationship is not meant to be. Things get worse when Caloy, Luna's ex-boyfriend, tries to win her back. Will Gali accept defeat against the stars? Or will Luna have a change of heart?
